{{Conjecture|legends}}
There was a '''combination tavern and eatery''' on the campus of the [[University of Alderaan/Legends|University of Alderaan]], situated off a secluded courtyard with a rainbow-colored fountain in front of it. It served "[[nerf]] cubes and [[tuber]]s in [[Wine/Legends|wine]] sauce" as a special, [[Flatbread/Legends|flatbread]] and [[Alderaanian ale]]. There was a small stage where live entertainment performed, including a girl who sang a traditional Alderaanian ballad accompanied by a [[mandoviol]].<ref name="The Paradise Snare">''[[The Paradise Snare]]''</ref>
